body:
In the encoding analyze phase ALP calculates a multiplier, it does so for scaling the estimated bytes of the sample set to the total value count. This multiplier however is truncated, so for example x2.9 would become x2, leading to inaccurate size estimates. In addition, segment-scoped metadata was over counted and vector-scoped metadata was omitted.

We've also relaxed the minimum block size from 256KiB to 32KiB when we don't support the uncompressed fallback, since we'll never write close to 32KiB for a single vector anyway (exact calculation is present in a comment above the constant).
title: Improve ALP size estimate and relax block size requirement
